messages:
nina: FYI a tail latency spike in eu-west dedicated-pool-1 at 03:21 UTC. GPUs look fine but hosts started reporting TX queue backs and a cascade of TCP RSTs to clients.

omar: can you paste the host counters?

nina: TX_queue_depth went from ~20 -> 600 on ~6 hosts, tx_dropped spiked, and SNAT ephemeral ports pegged on the egress gateway. seems tied to a new tenant rollout that does aggressive prefix prefetch + rapid short connections.

lee: sounds similar to the prefill fanout we've seen before. do we have per-tenant egress shaping active for prefetches?

nina: we have soft shaping for normal requests but prefetch uses separate short-lived connections that bypass some shapers. logs show prefill concurrency=40 from tenant Q around 03:20.

omar: quick mitigation options: 1) apply kinetic override to cap prefill concurrency for tenant Q to 4 for 1h, 2) divert pool egress to alternate SNAT instances with spare port space, 3) enable connection pooling in the agent for warmers.

lee: do 1+2 immediately. I'll prep a scheduler change to add per-allocation scatter jitter for prefill fanout (spread 200200ms) so siblings won't align.

ops-bot: applying override: {"tenant":"Q","prefill_concurrency":4,"ttl":"1h"} (id ov-299a).

net-bot: routing change: eu-west/dedicated-pool-1 -> snat-12,snat-13 applied (route id r-299b).

nina: after overrides and reroute 95p latency down from 210ms -> 38ms in ~4m. tx_queue_depth back to normal on hosts.

omar: follow-ups: infra to add per-tenant ephemeral-port accounting + alerting at 60% of a snat instance capacity; scheduler to add scatter/jitter PR; platform to require pooled warm connections in next client lib release.

lee: cost/time notes: routing shift uses existing capacity, override low cost. scheduler + infra + platform changes estimate ~2.5 dev days combined.

nina: open ticket #INF-7923 for follow-up items and a brief postmortem.

ops-bot: incident tag `noisy-prefill-snat` created. escalate if recurrence within 48h.
